about: Extra reference captures (npm run capture:reference -- --extra tests/golden/extra-cases.json). Each is a preset with overrides set after the preset and the seed. 'stipple' is the M2 acceptance variant (docs/roadmap.md): lines, knots and envelope off as the roadmap says, and also the drawn stars among the dots (starMix), the deep field (field) and the foreground stars (fgstars), which are vector or sky marks that arrive in later milestones; with them on, v21's plate holds ink the M2 engine does not draw yet. trails is already 0 in these presets.
